name: Compromised Third-Party Vendor Access
description: Adversary compromises external maintenance vendor credentials, authenticates via SSL-VPN, pivots through DMZ jump host into MES server, and attempts unauthorized Modbus interaction with manufacturing SMT PLCs.
detection_hypothesis: Multi-stage correlation: Anomaly in vendor auth (off-hours/foreign ASN) followed by cross-VLAN pivot to MES server and unauthorized Modbus/TCP traffic targeting SMT PLCs.
mitigation_actions: Terminate FortiClient SSL-VPN tunnel for vendor session
Revoke Active Directory vendor user account credentials
Notify on-duty OT plant engineer for physical line safety confirmation prior to OT isolation

name: Service Credential Misuse & API Abuse
description: Stolen machine-to-machine service account credentials (svc_erp_integration) reused from an unapproved endpoint to query confidential supplier records and manipulate WMS dispatch orders.
detection_hypothesis: API behavioral divergence: Sudden burst of HTTP POST/DELETE requests from a service account normally limited to periodic GET requests, combined with IP binding violation.
mitigation_actions: Invalidate active OAuth2 bearer token in Redis token store
Quarantine originating host IP via FortiGate dynamic address group
Place programmatic hold on pending dispatch order batch in WMS

name: Suspicious Multi-VLAN Lateral Movement
description: Compromised administrative workstation executes high-fanout port scans and credential brute-force attempts across Corporate, Engineering, and Manufacturing subnets.
detection_hypothesis: Graph anomaly and fanout detection: Single internal source initiating rapid multi-port connection requests (RDP, SMB, SSH) across 3 or more distinct VLAN boundaries in under 10 minutes.
mitigation_actions: Quarantine workstation switch port Gi1/0/21 via 802.1X re-auth
Force domain password reset and Kerberos ticket revocation for compromised admin
Block cross-VLAN route injection on core switch

name: Living off the Land (LotL) Execution
description: Adversary leverages signed Windows native administrative tools (powershell, certutil, schtasks, net) to download second-stage malware and establish persistence while evading static signatures.
detection_hypothesis: Endpoint-network fusion: PowerShell with obfuscated base64 command lines followed by CertUtil process making outbound HTTP requests with default CertUtil User-Agent.
mitigation_actions: Automated host network quarantine via FortiGate NAC agent
Kill suspicious child processes and remove unauthorized scheduled tasks
Purge rogue local administrative user account

name: Encrypted External Exfiltration
description: Long-lived encrypted TLS session from an engineering workstation leaking proprietary PCB Gerber design files and MCU firmware to an untrusted external IP without payload inspection.
detection_hypothesis: Statistical flow anomaly: High Byte Asymmetry Index (>0.95 outbound), abnormal session duration (>4 hours), and anomalous JA3/JA3S client fingerprint to newly registered domain.
mitigation_actions: Dynamic firewall drop rule for destination IP on FortiGate perimeter
Engineering workstation isolated to Remediation VLAN
Notify R&D Director and initiate intellectual property breach assessment

name: Manufacturing OT Network Anomaly
description: Unauthorized direct Modbus/TCP write commands from an engineering workstation altering SMT line conveyor drive speed registers, alongside rogue Modbus FC8 diagnostic probes.
detection_hypothesis: Industrial protocol semantic validation: Modbus FC6/FC16 write commands targeting holding register 40003 originating from an unauthorized IP outside designated HMI controllers.
mitigation_actions: SAFETY LOCK ENGAGED: Automated switchport isolation inhibited for PLC
Audible and visual alarm triggered in SMT Line A control room
Isolate originating workstation in Engineering segment away from plant floor
Require physical plant engineer confirmation before line parameter reset

name: Vulnerability Exposure & Active Reconnaissance
description: Active network reconnaissance using SYN scanning and aggressive service banner probing discovering unpatched assets (SMBGhost, outdated OpenSSH, Flask debug console).
detection_hypothesis: Reconnaissance signature matching: High-frequency TCP SYN packet rate across diverse ports combined with Nmap OS/version fingerprinting probes and known CVE correlation.
mitigation_actions: Firewall drop filter for scanning IP on perimeter and inter-VLAN interfaces
Issue urgent patch advisory for CVE-2020-0796 on CORP-WS-004 and Flask configuration on OT-MES01
